I told Hollis in a reply to his thread in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47.

On Oct 14, Pree first posted Dock 23, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing posted in #central-team since then changes that. I checked that Hollis is a member of the channel before using it to answer him. The brain search didn't turn up anything newer about the lane's site.
